release: CyberForge AIO v1.9.9.1 · Localization and Runtime Fix Pack

validation.notes: 36 unittest modules were executed independently in bounded groups; see TEST_RESULTS_1.9.9.1.md. This is not represented as one uninterrupted aggregate run.

netlab_runtime: Docker only; Linux container; not a VM
netlab_pcap_interface: Docker network namespace loopback lo only
netlab_pcap_payload_warning: Raw PCAP may contain secrets/payload; never automatically included in AI context or remote upload
netlab_pid_attribution: best-effort /proc sample-side socket inode lookup, correlated with PCAP 5-tuples when ports match
netlab_snapshot_scope: sample staging + bounded report/PCAP + last five run evidence; not live memory/disk snapshot
netlab_restore: prevalidated staged restore with reversible path swaps
netlab_automatic_container_cleanup: --rm plus idempotent rm; timeout kill/rm and explicit retention cleanup by exact labels
netlab_run_comparison: two sessions or two runs of the same session; timeline signatures
local_first_ai_optional_network_assist: OSV package metadata query only; fixed HTTPS host, bounded response, separate per-request consent
qwencloud_qwen3_8_max: qwen3.8-max; paid token API; explicit paid acknowledgement; no free fallback
docker_desktop_real_host_test: Not executed in build environment; user-run acceptance script provided.
pcap_capture_test_status: Unit tested; live Docker Desktop/Windows packet capture pending target-host acceptance script.

dev_studio_v196.fallback_editor: built-in textarea editor remains available when Monaco cannot be loaded
editor_features: language-aware Monaco tokenization and built-in JS/TS/JSON/HTML/CSS language services
Format Document when a Monaco language formatter is available
Go to Definition and Rename Symbol where a language provider supports it
workbench_features: Quick Open by project file path
AI debug and reviewed multi-file patch workflow
dev_studio_v196.lsp_support: Existing inventory detects installed language servers; full Monaco LSP client/workbench extension host is not included in this release.
dev_studio_v196.host_command_execution: Explicit terminal/code_execution permission; not sandboxed. Use the existing isolated runner for supported isolated snippets.

dev_studio_v197.debuggee_execution: Explicit local approval; runs with current OS user permissions, not malware sandbox.

dev_studio_v198.extension_manager: VSIX/CFEXT import as declarative-only data contributions
dev_studio_v198.dap_target_execution: Explicit user approval; local host OS permissions; not sandboxed

terminal.interactive_tui: Available only when a PTY/ConPTY backend and local xterm assets are both present
terminal.execution_permissions: code_execution; current OS user; not sandboxed

i18n.error_messages: Normalized application-generated request, permission, storage, dependency and network errors are localized. Raw stack traces, paths, code and third-party output remain verbatim.
i18n.fallback_policy: When the current locale has no reviewed translation, restore the original source string instead of retaining text from the previously selected locale; English catalog fallback is used only where a source-to-English mapping exists.
i18n.translation_completion_tool: tools/translate_catalogs.py; opt-in local Ollama only; drafts untranslated UI strings and preserves placeholders; no cloud requests.
i18n.authored_message_coverage: Reported in TEST_RESULTS_1.9.9.1.md and by tools/i18n_check.py; not 100% for all languages.

system_settings.application_preferences: local profile: locale, theme, accent, density and sidebar width
system_settings.machine_inventory: bounded, read-only OS/CPU/memory/disk/network summary and PATH presence checks for selected tools
system_settings.os_settings: fixed allowlisted settings pages; requires host_app_launch permission; no direct registry/preference/driver/firewall writes
system_settings.maintenance: health diagnostics and verified SQLite database-only backups; output mirrored in dashboard and System Settings

ui_redesign.scope: shared design system applied across existing workspace pages without changing route/API identifiers
